theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fc_cauchy_subseq
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (X : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsOpen U → (∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ 𝒬 : Set (GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), 𝒬.Finite ∧ ∀ j, ∃ Q ∈ 𝒬, ∃ (R : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 2)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity R ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity S ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), X j ω - Q ω = R.boundary ω + S ω) ∧ R.mass + S.mass < ε) → ∃ θ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono θ ∧ ∀ r, ∃ (R : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 2)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity R ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity S ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), X (θ (r + 1)) ω - X (θ r) ω = R.boundary ω + S ω) ∧ R.mass + S.mass ≤ (2⁻¹ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ r
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
